attchmntText: Spacenet Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Spacenet Enterprises India Limited has published its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The publication was released in the Financial Express and Nava Telangana newspapers on 14th November 2026. This filing complies with Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company requests the National Stock Exchange of India Limited to take the publication on record.

attchmntText: Spacenet Enterprises India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Mrs. Krishna Veni Ambala as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Spacenet Enterprises India Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. The Board appointed Mrs. Krishna Veni Ambala, DIN 12041206, as an Additional Director, Non-Executive Independent Director, effective 13th November 2026. Her appointment for five consecutive years ending 12th November 2031 is subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot. The company also reconstituted the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and Stakeholders Relationship Committee. For the half-year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 10,258.80 lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 2,052.64 lakhs. The Board Meeting was held on 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Spacenet Enterprises India Limited has informed regarding Disclosure of material issue
voiceSummary: Spacenet Enterprises India Limited disclosed the sale of 40,00,000 equity shares of String Metaverse Limited through open-market transactions on BSE Limited on 12-11-2026. The shares were sold at a weighted average price of Rs. 6.81 per share. This resulted in an aggregate gross sale consideration of approximately Rs. 272.40 lakh, before brokerage, taxes, and other transaction charges. The transaction represents a partial disposal of the Company’s investment in String Metaverse Limited. The sale is considered material by value as the gross consideration exceeds the applicable numerical materiality threshold. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The information is also available on the Company’s website at www.spacenetent.com.
